title: MISP Dealer Surveyor Interference & Unapproved Fee Inflation
description: Tests retrieval of MISP Guideline 10(g-h) prohibiting automobile dealers from interfering in surveyor appointments or inflating claims revenue with dealer handling fees.

claim_packet.incident_narrative: Vehicle collided with highway guardrail damaging front bumper and headlight. MISP dealership insisted on appointing their own internal surveyor and added dealer administrative handling charges to the estimate.

expected_retrieval_topics: interfere in the appointment of surveyors

title: Single Insurer Coercion & Lack of Policy Choice at MISP Dealer
description: Tests retrieval of MISP Guideline 10(a-b) mandating automobile dealers to offer choices of multiple insurers and disclose comparative premium rates to prospects.

claim_packet.incident_narrative: Customer collided with concrete parking pillar. Policy was issued by car dealer who refused to offer alternative insurance quotes or show premium options from multiple insurers during sale.

expected_retrieval_topics: offer a choice of motor insurance policies of different insurer
inform the prospect of the premium rates

title: Dealer Branded Cover Note & Unapproved Custom Add-on Fee
description: Tests retrieval of MISP Guideline 10(j) & Chapter IV 14(a) prohibiting cover notes with dealer logos/branding and unfiled custom addon charges.

claim_packet.incident_narrative: Side impact damage to mirror and windshield from falling tree branch. Cover note issued by dealer bears MISP dealer logo instead of insurer name and includes unapproved dealer custom bodykit rider.

expected_retrieval_topics: cover note that carries name or logo or any other symbol, except that of the insurer

title: Electronic Premium Remittance & Section 64VB Compliance Verification
description: Tests retrieval of MISP Guideline 15(6) regarding mandatory electronic premium remittance by policyholders/dealers under Section 64VB of Insurance Act 1938.

claim_packet.incident_narrative: Major head-on collision on express highway causing total front end loss exceeding ₹50,000. Customer paid renewal premium via dealer cash remittance subject to Section 64VB verification.

title: Dealer Infrastructure Charge & Multi-Sponsoring Insurer Audit
description: Tests retrieval of MISP Guideline 15(5)(d) strictly prohibiting insurers from paying and MISPs from receiving infrastructure, advertising, or documentation fees.

claim_packet.incident_narrative: Right front fender dented during parking. Repair estimate submitted by multi-brand dealership includes a separate MISP documentation and infrastructure handling charge.

expected_retrieval_topics: any other payment by whatever name called
